description: This file defines a template class 'Archetype' and related utilities for generating minimal conforming types based on 'Conformance Profiles'. It includes base classes for different special member functions, comparison operators, and hash support, all conditioned on profile properties. Used for testing template support and type conformance.

classes.name: absl::types_internal::Archetype
classes.description: A template class representing a minimal archetype supporting specific conformance properties based on a profile.

classes.name: absl::types_internal::PropertiesOfArchetype
classes.description: Template struct to obtain properties of an Archetype based on its profile.

classes.name: absl::types_internal::IsArchetype
classes.description: Type trait to check if a type is an Archetype.

classes.name: absl::types_internal::ArchetypeStateBase
classes.description: Base class managing archetype internal state and default construction properties.

classes.name: absl::types_internal::ArchetypeMoveConstructor
classes.description: Base class implementing move constructor with specified noexcept and triviality properties.

classes.name: absl::types_internal::ArchetypeCopyConstructor
classes.description: Base class implementing copy constructor with specified noexcept and triviality properties.

classes.name: absl::types_internal::ArchetypeMoveAssign
classes.description: Base class implementing move assignment operator with specified noexcept.

classes.name: absl::types_internal::ArchetypeCopyAssign
classes.description: Base class implementing copy assignment operator with specified noexcept.

classes.name: absl::types_internal::ArchetypeDestructor
classes.description: Base class implementing destructor with specified noexcept.

methods.description: Function to create an Archetype instance with a given internal state.
